items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I knew Kaiser when he was with Fletcher. In fact, the first time I heard Fletcher before I left home Kaiser Marshall was the drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right, that's right. And he would use Fats Waller on piano and he would use Kaiser Marshall on drums and he'd always use Billy Taylor on bass and he used Truehart on guitar. Truehart was a guitar player with Chick Webb, a great rhythm guitar player. A great rhythm guitar player he was. Fantastic. I think he was the only guitar player Chick ever had --
